title: The agent-model-cap role table is the one home for each role's and round's model and effort, and every reader reads it
why: Owner 15:44 CST Nov 10 (R8, M1 a, relayed by the retrospective session): "on #1 -- A seems best".
note: Item 506 answer (owner 11:23 CST Nov 11, plan 2736d70): d with a. The coordinator and triage get a measured Sonnet trial in this evaluation. Earlier compaction applies only to a session that stays on Opus, set per model (modelSettings.<model>.autoCompactWindow; decision precompact-handoff rule 1; owner: "opus could compact tigheter than sonnet no?"). This step also finds why the coordinator compacts at 441,600 and seeded sessions at 384,000. Owner 11:21 CST asked which lanes, if any, should run Opus: debt lane-model-recheck folds in here (plan e1c6814). Ruling R33 (owner 11:09 CST Nov 11, plan ebf999a, item 3.7): every role has a chosen model and effort with a one-line reason. Rows no ruling chose today: main session, coordinator, triage, batch runner, general-purpose agents, every skill. Then an evaluation runs each role on the cheapest model that passes its checks, from measured outcomes per role and model (review pass rates, fix rounds, third tries, cost from R32's audit). A row moves only on a measured pass rate; above Sonnet needs the owner's grant. Runs after the R32 audit (step token-spend-sources). Home: decision agent-model-cap. One lane with step c201's left part (item 59 a, owner Oct 28 17:50 CDT; docs/todo.md line 9): one lane per role on one model step down, same brief shape, compared with the Measured part of agent-model-cap. The spawn guard requires the row's model and effort or fills them in (today it only permits them: guard.py:3783-3788; a no-model spawn runs reviewer.md's Haiku pin, so 17 sessions name a Haiku fix check). The merge tool checks the model that ran, not the record text. Agent frontmatter, brief markers, report_guard, check_agent_models and call_judge read the table. Each later model ruling lands in one lane that changes the table and every reader. Measured lag today 12-57 h (retrospective audit). Overlaps open lane agent-served-model-check (#2442, #2486). Home: decision agent-model-cap. Owner 13:52 CST Nov 11 (relayed by the retrospective; plan 573e708): "i'd say all three stay on opus for now until 3.7". The coordinator, triage and the batch runner respawn on Opus at the fresh start; their models are chosen in R33 (plan 3.7), with the measured Sonnet trial for the coordinator and triage from R32. Home: decision agent-model-cap. Plan R52 (owner 13:07 CST Nov 12, restart-plan 4c91998): "i just changed the batch runner for child repos and us to sonnet 5.5 at medium effort if no issues arise form it that can be its default". This ends the 13:52 CST Nov 11 all-Opus hold for the batch runner only; the coordinator and triage stay on Opus. Add a row for each of the three roles with its reason; Sonnet becomes the runner's default after its batches show no wrong drop, no wrong merge and no stalled batch. 06:32 CST Nov 13: done.
